source: R/smooth.r::smooth.construct.cr.smooth.spec, smooth.construct.cs.smooth.spec, smoothCon, Predict.matrix.cr.smooth; gam Gaussian fitting
execution: Actual installed CRAN mgcv captures; ordinary tests require no R.
scope: Distinct and repeated matrix quadrature with variable/unit/constant-sum weights. Raw CR/CS operators, cardinal-point prediction matrices, full fitted/prediction design, source scale and absorbed penalty, fit/covariance/EDF. Tests compare common-coordinate penalty transport, spectra AND non-null operator, and demonstrate that rotating unequal null floors changes actual fitted functions and covariance despite identical spectra/function spaces.
guard: Matrix cs stays unsupported: unequal null floors are source-basis-dependent and can change the function-space penalty. Raw coordinate/eigenvector differences alone are not evidence of a model gap. Source-penalty injection is diagnostic only and is not production parity.
